These procedure details the steps required 
to completely measure openning and closing times for one break per pole circuit 
breaker using CBT 400 breaker Test Set, every 6 months as indicated by M6 in the 
title block.

Note : This step by step instruction is for 
CBT 400 breaker analyzer Test Set (Hathaway-England ).

The first draft initiated & tested at 
Elaasher 220 substation by eng. Ebraheem Hasan from Elaasher protection management, reviewed by protection manager 
eng. Fawzy Barakat, accepted by general 
manager eng. Elsaaied Nagy, revised by quality control manager eng. Mohamed 
Emran, approved by eng. Wageeh Mansy Head Sector of Protection, 
Measurements & Testes Canal Zone, and accepted by eng. Aly Attiah el Deib 
EETC Canal Zone MPIS Coordinator.

items:
A work permit must be issued and the 
 qualified testing staff should carry the suitable safety categories.

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.

Wear 
 Safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.

Circuit breaker must be fully 
 isolated.

Circuit breaker must be properly 
 earthed on both sides of it, using earthing switch if present and 
 temporary local earthings.

CBT 400 test set unit (Hathaway, 
 England)
Test leads.
Voltmeter.

Clean the bushings of each phase of the breaker (if 
 necessary).

Connect your test cables clamps to the three poles of the 
 breaker at points cleaned in step 1.

Check CB auxiliary operating voltage (opening & closing 
 voltage).

Connect the other terminals of the cables to points A1-Com 
 ( phase R) , A2-Com
 (phase S) & A3-Com (phase T).

Connect the two terminals cable concerned with opening and 
 closing , where one terminal is connected to positive and the other is 
 connected to coil.
Check your connections according to the previous steps.

Connect the two terminals of closing cable where one terminal to closing 
 positive and the other is directly to closing coil as shown :
Switch the test unit power supply on.
From the initial screen Choose 2. Test.
From the breaker test options screen Choose 1. Simple test.

Choose 3. Close , then by pressing the key Enter the device will start 
 measuring.
Record the test results obtained in a table as shown below .
Switch the test unit power supply off.

Connect the two terminals of opening cable where one terminal to opening 
 positive and the other is directly to opening coil as shown below.
Switch the test unit power supply on.
From the initial screen Choose 2. Test.
From the breaker test options screen Choose 1. Simple test.

Choose 2. Open. , then by pressing the key Enter the device will start 
 measuring.
Record the test results obtained in a table as shown below .
Switch the test unit power supply off.

Beside open & close test you can do also the 
 following tests:

items: open / close close /open open /close /open

After finishing the tests :
 Disconnect the earthing switches if present or remove the 
 temporary local earthings .
 return the CB into 
 service

sections.text:
If one Result is not available this may be due to one of the 
followings:

items: The test cable terminal may be disconnected.
One of the clamps is not good fixed.
The two terminals cable of opening and closing is in incorrect position.
There is no negative on the coil.
No paper roll is present on the test unit.

Introduction
These procedure details the steps required 
to completely measure openning and closing times for one break per pole circuit 
breaker using CBT 400 breaker Test Set, every 6 months as indicated by M6 in the 
title block.
Note : This step by step instruction is for 
CBT 400 breaker analyzer Test Set (Hathaway-England ).
The first draft initiated & tested at 
Elaasher 220 substation by eng. Ebraheem Hasan from Elaasher protection management, reviewed by protection manager 
eng. Fawzy Barakat, accepted by general 
manager eng. Elsaaied Nagy, revised by quality control manager eng. Mohamed 
Emran, approved by eng. Wageeh Mansy Head Sector of Protection, 
Measurements & Testes Canal Zone, and accepted by eng. Aly Attiah el Deib 
EETC Canal Zone MPIS Coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the 
 qualified testing staff should carry the suitable safety categories.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.
Wear 
 Safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
Circuit breaker must be fully 
 isolated.
Circuit breaker must be properly 
 earthed on both sides of it, using earthing switch if present and 
 temporary local earthings.
Tools and Equipment
CBT 400 test set unit (Hathaway, 
 England)
Test leads.
Voltmeter.
Work to be Carried Out
Circuit Breaker
Clean the bushings of each phase of the breaker (if 
 necessary).
Connect your test cables clamps to the three poles of the 
 breaker at points cleaned in step 1.
Check CB auxiliary operating voltage (opening & closing 
 voltage).
CBT 400 Test Set
Connect the other terminals of the cables to points A1-Com 
 ( phase R) , A2-Com
 (phase S) & A3-Com (phase T).
Connect the two terminals cable concerned with opening and 
 closing , where one terminal is connected to positive and the other is 
 connected to coil.
Measurement of Closing Time
Check your connections according to the previous steps.
Connect the two terminals of closing cable where one terminal to closing 
 positive and the other is directly to closing coil as shown :
Switch the test unit power supply on.
From the initial screen Choose 2. Test.
From the breaker test options screen Choose 1. Simple test.
Choose 3. Close , then by pressing the key Enter the device will start 
 measuring.
Record the test results obtained in a table as shown below .
Switch the test unit power supply off.
Measurement of Opening Time
Connect the two terminals of opening cable where one terminal to opening 
 positive and the other is directly to opening coil as shown below.
Switch the test unit power supply on.
From the initial screen Choose 2. Test.
From the breaker test options screen Choose 1. Simple test.
Choose 2. Open. , then by pressing the key Enter the device will start 
 measuring.
Record the test results obtained in a table as shown below .
Switch the test unit power supply off.
Note:
Beside open & close test you can do also the 
 following tests:
open / close close /open open /close /open
open / close close /open open /close /open
After finishing the tests :
 Disconnect the earthing switches if present or remove the 
 temporary local earthings .
 return the CB into 
 service
If one Result is not available this may be due to one of the 
followings:
The test cable terminal may be disconnected.
One of the clamps is not good fixed.
The two terminals cable of opening and closing is in incorrect position.
There is no negative on the coil.
No paper roll is present on the test unit.
